BR-02.title: No dependency-closed pinned upstream source for the C23 gap

BR-03.title: FE_TIESAWAY has no host or upstream value on this toolchain
BR-03.detail: AUDIT_FINDINGS_TRACKER NUMWIDE-08: compiler macro absent; no host/upstream value available.

BR-04.title: Type-generic atomics cannot be represented as one C ABI symbol
BR-04.affected: 34/948 ISO C APIs (27 C11 stdatomic + 7 C23 atomic additions)
BR-04.detail: C11 _Generic macros expand to compiler type-generic builtins; no standalone cplus_atomic_* C99 function is shipped. Host __atomic_* builtins are used internally only.

BR-05.title: macOS host CRT lacks ISO C11 Annex K semantics
BR-05.affected: 13/948 ISO C APIs (11 stdio Annex K + 2 stdlib Annex K sort/search with context)
BR-05.detail: Not shipped as a portable ISO API. A separate SafeCRT _s family exists in stdlib/safe but is not the ISO Annex K contract.

BR-06.title: ISO C entry removed or deliberately excluded for insecurity

BR-06.detail: Documented alternative: bounded fgets / cplus_fgets and cplus_tmpfile or mkstemp (cplus_mkstemp). No scope-resolution decision has converted these rows out of UNSUPPORTED.
